item.title: Apple’s new AirTags are back down to their best price
item.description: We spotted a great deal on Tile trackers earlier this week that’s still live, but if you’re an iPhone owner, we ultimately recommend Apple’s latest AirTag. Right now, you can pick up a four-pack for $89 ($10 off) at Amazon and Target, matching the bundle’s all-time low price. If you’re a member, Costco also has […]

item.title: How is your enterprise tracking AI agent telemetry? Groundcover thinks it should never leave your cloud
item.description: The AI agent observability space is taking off — but how can enterprises be sure what observability products and solutions they need?Observability startup groudcover (lower case "g" intentional) announced this week that it raised $100 million in a round led by One Peak, bringing its total funding to $160 million. The company says it has more than 250 paying customers, tripled annual recurring revenue over the past year and is increasingly replacing established observability platforms inside enterprise environments. Those are company-reported figures, but together they point to growing momentum...

item.title: New York alleges Kalshi is running an 'illegal gambling operation' in new lawsuit
item.description: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has already been sued by multiple states.

item.title: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
item.description: Google has shut down Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI. The tool essentially let users create AI deepfakes of the real world using text prompts; Digital Digging's Henk van Ess, for example, intentionally generated images adding things like refugees near the Mexican border […]...

item.title: Snapchat is cracking down on AI slop in Spotlight
item.description: Videos made with AI will no longer appear in Snapchat's public recommendations.

item.title: Google rolls back the needless AI generation tools it added to Google Earth
item.description: People had less than a day to make misleading Google Earth images with AI before Google pulled the feature.

item.title: Ukraine built a stealth electric bike that powers drones and zooms over landmines
item.description: Ukraine approves MUL.E electric military motorcycle combining minefield mobility, drone charging capability and frontline transport for demanding combat operations.

item.title: Trou noir : le souffle équivalent à plusieurs milliards d'explosions de supernovae secoue un amas de galaxies
item.description: Les trous noirs supermassifs qui font évoluer les galaxies nous réservent sans aucun doute des surprises. La dernière en date concerne maintenant les amas de galaxies et leurs interactions avec ces astres compacts géants.

item.title: VC-backed startups commit more fraud, and researchers think they know why
item.description: New research from the U.K.’s Imperial College and France’s Emlyon Business School mapped out how Silicon Valley founders commit fraud — and the role investors play.

item.title: A K-pop group launched a lemon 30 kilometers above Earth. Heres how they did it.
item.description: Hearts2Hearts' "Lemon Tang" rollout culminated in a delightfully over-the-top comeback campaign that launched a lemon into near space.

item.title: 'We've set this company up in preparation for this moment' — as PlayStation scraps discs, these companies are ready to keep physical games alive
item.description: I spoke to some of the companies keeping physical games media alive in the wake of PlayStation's pivot to a digital-only future, and what they're continuing to do to provide fans with the experience they want from physical goods.

item.title: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
item.description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is probing nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles after receiving complaints about a suspension failure that could cause "a loss of vehicle directional control," as reported earlier by Reuters. The preliminary investigation includes the 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2021-2023 Model Y, according to a filing from the NHTSA's Office […]...

item.title: Pandora's ad-free subscription is less than $10 a month in 2026: Is it worth it?
item.description: The Pandora experience is different from the Spotify one most of us are used to. Pandora Premium is worth it for some.

item.title: Google might launch a ‘Pixel Tag’
item.description: Google is seemingly working on an item tracker that might compete with Apple's AirTag. 9to5Google obtained an image of something called a "Google Pixel Tag" that has a small oval shape. The publication also linked to a Slovenian store listing about the Pixel Tag that describes the gadget as an item tracker with a speaker […]

item.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
item.description: As OpenAI and Anthropic employees grow quieter online, researchers at Chinese AI labs are flocking to X to explain their work, recruit talent, and shape the global conversation on AI.

item.title: New York sues Kalshi, calling it an ‘illegal gambling operation’
item.description: In a court filing, NY state officials estimated the damages and costs sought by the lawsuit to be $36 billion. New York officials sued prediction market platform Kalshi for potentially billions of dollars on Friday, calling it an “illegal, unlicensed gambling operation” that includes sports wagering as the state seeks to halt its operations and force the company to forfeit its profits....

item.title: Miss your CD collection? This wall-mounted display for Spotify and Apple Music promises to bring back its ‘feeling of connection’ — but its maker insists he doesn’t want to kill off physical media
item.description: Spine Music founder Ricardo Amorim is putting his love for albums and CD collecting into a new digital music display.
